ja.title: ctDNAの連続陽性を待つと偽陽性はどこまで減るか
ja.summary: 術後ctDNAの単回偽陽性率を1%にそろえ、1回の陽性と2回連続陽性を判定規則として比較した。偽陽性が同じ患者に続くと、確認採血で減らせる偽陽性患者数が変わる。
ja.seo_title: 術後ctDNAの連続陽性と偽陽性

en.title: How far can two consecutive ctDNA positives reduce false positives?
en.summary: A probability model compares one positive with two consecutive positives in postoperative ctDNA testing at the same single-draw false-positive rate. Persistent false positives can erase the benefit of a confirmation draw.
en.seo_title: Serial ctDNA testing and persistent false positives
en.seo_description: A probability model compares one positive with two consecutive positives in postoperative ctDNA testing at a fixed single-draw false-positive rate.
